Worker consistency requires all archived lease rows released. Thus known old lease remains empty in the frozen recovery archive and strict collector correctly rejects it.

_unreleased_lease_count queries released_at IS NULL, while real schema released_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT empty string and insert uses empty string. It returns0 for known unreleased empty-string rows. New observer schema-aware positive control is required.

Do not change these to expiry checks or arbitrary truthy values. Observed collector correctly reports recovery lease_released=false.
